name: President Hopper

tenures.source: The fed's own founder and on-screen president, presiding over its weekly broadcasts and, on 9 September 1998, announcing its merger with the Anarchy e-mail Wrestling Federation into NaWF/AeWF at a televised press conference.

caption: The fed's own founder and on-screen president, who announced its merger with the Anarchy e-mail Wrestling Federation on 9 September 1998.

name: Gorilla
notes: Known only from the RSPWF Top 200, the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll. Placings and the poll's own federation tags, verbatim — 1998: #126, tagged NeCW, AeWF, HOW; 2000: #177, tagged UEW, RCW, ACCW. Carries no tenure entry: none of the tagged federations is a held promotion, and the poll records where a wrestler was tagged, never a run this record could date.
caption: Lost the vacant Dangerzone Championship to Simon McQuaid, then fell short again in the match for the first North American Tag Team title.

tenures.note: Half of the suspended tag team the Crazed Animals (with the Psychotic Doctor); interfered in the Monday Night Battlezone main event and was arrested by police on-air on 14 September; reinstated by a court ruling shown on 21 September, then eliminated late that same night from the Dangerzone battle royal by masked-faction interference before a winner could be named; lost the vacant Dangerzone Championship to Simon McQuaid on 28 September after his own tag partner's interference backfired; eliminated by masked interference himself, then pinned when Night Patrol's own weapon shot missed its target, in the 2 October match for the vacant North American Tag Team Championship.

name: Jack Strange
notes: Known only from the RSPWF Top 200, the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll. Placings and the poll's own federation tags, verbatim — 1997: #69, tagged NeCW. Carries no tenure entry: none of the tagged federations is a held promotion, and the poll records where a wrestler was tagged, never a run this record could date.
caption: Manages "Bashful" Sammy Parker, present at ringside when the Crazed Animals attacked his charge backstage.

tenures.note: Manages "Bashful" Sammy Parker; present at ringside on 4 September when the Crazed Animals attacked Parker backstage ahead of a scheduled match that never happened.

name: Psychotic Doctor

tenures.note: Lost to Burden on 4 September after Gorilla called out the Crazed Animals, then mockingly wrestled a blow-up doll standing in for the injured Sammy Parker in the same broadcast; half of the suspended tag team the Crazed Animals (with Gorilla); interfered in the Monday Night Battlezone main event and was arrested by police on-air on 14 September; part of the four-way tag dance on 11 September, winning for his team with Gorilla's submission finisher; part of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal and its court-case angle; lost a dark match to Ryu Yamamoto by disqualification on 28 September; eliminated by masked interference in the 2 October four-way match for the vacant North American Tag Team Championship.

caption: Half of the suspended tag team the Crazed Animals, arrested alongside his partner after interfering in a main event.

name: Burden

tenures.note: Beat the Psychotic Doctor on 4 September after calling out the Crazed Animals; lost the Monday Night Battlezone opener to Bobby "Bad Apple" Durango on 14 September; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat the on-air debuting "Mr. Excitement" Alex Extreme on 28 September; won a chaotic backstage-to-ringside brawl with Rune by disqualification on 2 October after interference from Gorilla and, later, the debuting Smith Twins.

caption: Lost the Monday Night Battlezone opener to Bobby "Bad Apple" Durango.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated RSPWF Top 200 stub tagged to different, later federations; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: "Bad Apple" Bobby Durango

tenures.note: Beat Gorilla on 4 September after ambushing him from the crowd; debuted a darker "possessed" gimmick to beat Burden on 14 September; beat "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams on 11 September; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal and attacked Shane Larson backstage the same night; won the promotion's rubber match with "Malicious" Mike Hrankiwskyj on 28 September in a falls-count-anywhere brawl; menaced Shane Larson's wife Robin at ringside and beat Larson down with a chair after the bell on 2 October.

caption: Debuted a darker, "possessed" gimmick to beat Burden on Monday Night Battlezone.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated character tenured at a different, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: Night

tenures.note: Debuted in a dark match on 11 September, beating Enrique Valasquez; made his on-air debut against "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams on 14 September and lost by submission; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; lost to the newly renamed TORA Wanizame (formerly Kabuki Master) on 2 October.

caption: Made his on-air debut against "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams and lost by submission.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated wrestler at a different, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams

tenures.note: Lost the promotion's main event cage match to Kabuki Master on 4 September; beat debuting wrestler Night by submission with the Deep Freeze on 14 September; signed for a ladder match against Kabuki Master at the promotion's first pay-per-view and beat Bobby Durango on 11 September; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat Shane Larson on 28 September; challenged Simon McQuaid for the Dangerzone Championship and lost on 2 October.

caption: Beat debuting wrestler Night by submission with the Deep Freeze on Monday Night Battlezone.

name: "Malicious" Mike Hrankiwskyj

tenures.note: Scheduled to face "Bashful" Sammy Parker on 4 September, but was beaten backstage by the Crazed Animals before the bout, which never happened; beat Sengir on Monday Night Battlezone on 14 September, then beat him down with brass knuckles after the bell; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; lost the promotion's rubber match with Bobby Durango in a falls-count-anywhere brawl on 28 September, the latest document to show him.

caption: Beat Sengir on Monday Night Battlezone, then beat him down with brass knuckles after the bell.

name: "Lightning" Kent Powers

tenures.note: One half of the tag team the SuperPowers (with "Sabre" Scott Powers); their 4 September bout with the Chippendales was called off for injury, then reinstated at the team's own insistence and won; lost the Monday Night Battlezone main event to the Mongolian Assassins on a disputed pinfall on 14 September; lost the 11 September four-way tag dance and the 21 September bout with Night Patrol; eliminated first in the 2 October four-way match for the vacant North American Tag Team Championship.

caption: One half of the SuperPowers, who lost a disputed main event to the Mongolian Assassins.

name: "Sabre" Scott Powers

tenures.note: One half of the tag team the SuperPowers (with "Lightning" Kent Powers); their 4 September bout with the Chippendales was called off for injury, then reinstated at the team's own insistence and won; lost the Monday Night Battlezone main event to the Mongolian Assassins on a disputed pinfall on 14 September, after which suspended wrestlers the Crazed Animals interfered; lost the 11 September four-way tag dance and the 21 September bout with Night Patrol; eliminated alongside the Psychotic Doctor by masked interference in the 2 October four-way match for the vacant North American Tag Team Championship.

caption: One half of the SuperPowers, pinned in a disputed main-event finish.

name: Kublai

tenures.note: One half of the tag team the Mongolian Assassins (with Genghis); one of two unidentified men who beat down the Crazed Animals then turned on the SuperPowers on 4 September, identified as the Assassins in a later broadcast's recap; won the Monday Night Battlezone main event over the SuperPowers on 14 September with a top-rope elbow drop finisher, "the Twilight Drop"; part of the four-way tag dance on 11 September and the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat Night Patrol on 28 September; won the vacant North American Tag Team Championship on 2 October, submitting to Gorilla's finisher mid-match before his partner Genghis won the deciding fall.

caption: One half of the Mongolian Assassins, who won a disputed main event over the SuperPowers.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (kublai-mcw-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Genghis

tenures.note: One half of the tag team the Mongolian Assassins (with Kublai); one of two unidentified men who beat down the Crazed Animals then turned on the SuperPowers on 4 September, identified as the Assassins in a later broadcast's recap; scored the Monday Night Battlezone main-event win over the SuperPowers on 14 September with his finisher, "the Twilight Drop"; part of the four-way tag dance on 11 September and the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat Night Patrol on 28 September; won the vacant North American Tag Team Championship on 2 October, pinning Gorilla after Night Patrol's Lt. Blazer accidentally struck him with a billy club meant for Genghis.

caption: One half of the Mongolian Assassins, who won the Monday Night Battlezone main event with the Twilight Drop.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (genghis-mcw-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Coffin Bearer

tenures.note: A local enhancement wrestler with an Undertaker-styled gimmick, beaten by debuting Simon "Thunderstryke" McQuaid in a dark match on Monday Night Battlezone.

caption: A local enhancement wrestler beaten by debuting Simon McQuaid in a dark match.

name: Kabuki Master

tenures.note: Won the promotion's main-event cage match over "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams on 4 September; beat a local enhancement wrestler in a dark match on 14 September; beat "Malicious" Mike Hrankiwskyj by disqualification on 11 September, then signed for a ladder match against Williams at the promotion's first pay-per-view; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; renamed TORA Wanizame after a supercard appearance in Japan, won a 28 September bout by forfeit when his scheduled opponent was fired, then beat Night on 2 October.

caption: Beat a local enhancement wrestler in a dark match with the Stardust Press.

identity.note: A ring name also used, unrelated, by a wrestler at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: The Phlying Phanatic

tenures.note: A local enhancement wrestler who flipped off the crowd on his way to the ring, then lost to Kabuki Master by pinfall in a dark match on Monday Night Battlezone.

caption: A local enhancement wrestler beaten by Kabuki Master in a dark match.

name: Enrique Valasquez

tenures.note: Debuted in a dark match on 4 September, losing to Sengir; lost to "Mr. Excitement" Alex Extreme in a dark match on Monday Night Battlezone on 14 September; lost to Night in a dark match on 11 September; eliminated early from the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal, bodyslammed over the top alongside Black Widow; lost a dark match to the debuting English Avenger on 2 October, the latest document to show him.

caption: Lost to "Mr. Excitement" Alex Extreme in a dark match on Monday Night Battlezone.

name: Ryu Yamamoto

tenures.note: Lost his on-air debut to Simon "Thunderstryke" McQuaid on a sunset flip; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal before being shoved off the top rope through a table by the Psychotic Doctor; lost a dark match to the Psychotic Doctor by disqualification on 28 September after Gorilla interfered.

caption: Lost his on-air debut to Simon McQuaid, then reached the elite eight of the Dangerzone battle royal.

name: Spellbinder

tenures.note: Managed by David Bahner; debuted with a win over Rune broken up by interference from a masked faction and Rune himself, who beat him and hog-tied his manager afterward; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat Shane Larson on 2 October with a Razor's Edge-style powerbomb, Larson's first loss, after Bobby Durango distracted Larson mid-match.

caption: Debuted with a beatdown loss to Rune, then beat Shane Larson for the upstart's first defeat.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated wrestler at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: The Full Monty

tenures.note: Half of the flamboyant, striptease-gimmicked tag team the Chippendales (with Dick Steele); the Chippendales' 4 September bout with the SuperPowers was called off for injury and never officially contested; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal by eliminating himself with a suicide dive onto Shane Larson; lost the 28 September four-way tag main event and a 2 October dark match to Wardancer by disqualification after using a chair.

caption: Half of the striptease-gimmicked tag team the Chippendales, eliminated from the Dangerzone battle royal by his own suicide dive.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (full-monty-mcw-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Dick Steele

tenures.note: Half of the tag team the Chippendales (with the Full Monty); lost the 11 September four-way tag dance and the 18 September bout with Night Patrol, both alongside his partner; lost a 2 October dark match to the debuting Knick Man by pinfall.

caption: Half of the tag team the Chippendales, beaten by the debuting Knick Man in a dark match.

name: Rune

tenures.note: An English wrestler; debuted by beating Spellbinder, then joined a masked attacker in beating Spellbinder down further and hog-tying his manager after the bell; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; beat a local enhancement wrestler in a 28 September dark match; lost to Burden by disqualification on 2 October after Gorilla's interference backfired into a Pearl Harbor attack on Gorilla, then was offered a spot in a new stable by the debuting Smith Twins.

caption: An English wrestler offered a spot in the debuting Smith Twins' new stable after a disqualification loss to Burden.

identity.note: A ring name also used, unrelated, by a wrestler at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: Shane Larson

tenures.note: Managed to the ring by his wife, Robin; scored a career-making upset over "The Flyer" Jinsei Shakanuzi on his own debut, forcing Shakanuzi's retirement from the promotion; reached the elite eight of the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal; lost to "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams on 28 September; lost his first fall in the promotion to Spellbinder on 2 October after Bobby Durango menaced Robin at ringside mid-match, then was beaten down with a chair by Durango after the bell while Robin stood transfixed.

caption: Scored a career-making upset debut over Jinsei Shakanuzi, forcing the veteran's retirement.

name: Jinsei Shakanuzi

tenures.note: A high-flying former AeWF World champion by the announce team's own account; lost his only match in the promotion, an on-air debut against Shane Larson decided by a last-second kick, and retired from the promotion on the loss.

caption: Retired from the promotion after a last-second loss to Shane Larson in his own debut match.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (jinsei-shakanuzi-gpro98); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Black Widow

tenures.note: Half of the guest tag team the Spiderz, from a local independent promotion (with Brown Recluse); eliminated early from the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal, bodyslammed over the top alongside Enrique Valasquez by Gorilla.

caption: Half of the guest tag team the Spiderz, eliminated early from the Dangerzone battle royal.

identity.note: A ring name shared with unrelated wrestlers at separate, unrelated federations; nothing links this wrestler to those.

name: Brown Recluse

tenures.note: Half of the guest tag team the Spiderz, from a local independent promotion (with Black Widow); eliminated from the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal along with both members of the Mongolian Assassins in a triple over-the-top spot.

caption: Half of the guest tag team the Spiderz, eliminated from the Dangerzone battle royal in a triple spot.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (brown-recluse-mcw-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Sgt. Garcia

tenures.note: Half of the law-and-order tag team Night Patrol (with Lt. Blazer), managed by Assistant DA Brenda Hawkins; debuted in a 11 September dark match win over a local team; lost the 18 September bout to the Chippendales narrowly before their partners turned it around; eliminated from the 21 September SuperPowers match and the 2 October four-way tag main event, pinned by the Mongolian Assassins' Genghis.

caption: One half of Night Patrol, managed by Assistant DA Brenda Hawkins.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (rey-garcia-mcw-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Lt. Blazer

tenures.note: Half of the law-and-order tag team Night Patrol (with Sgt. Garcia), managed by Assistant DA Brenda Hawkins; debuted in a 11 September dark match win over a local team; won the 18 September bout with the Chippendales with a powerbomb; on the losing end of the 21 September match with the SuperPowers and the 2 October four-way tag main event for the new North American Tag Team Championship.

caption: One half of Night Patrol, managed by Assistant DA Brenda Hawkins.

name: "Bashful" Sammy Parker

tenures.note: Managed by Jack Strange; scheduled to face "Malicious" Mike Hrankiwskyj on 4 September, but was beaten and injured backstage by the Crazed Animals before the match, which the Doc then mocked by wrestling a blow-up doll dressed as Parker in his place.

caption: Beaten and injured backstage by the Crazed Animals before his own scheduled match.

name: The English Avenger

tenures.note: A masked wrestler from the United Kingdom; won his first match in the promotion, a dark-match pinfall over Enrique Valasquez with an inverted powerbomb.

caption: A masked British debutant who beat Enrique Valasquez in a dark match.

name: Knick Man

tenures.note: Debuted in a dark match, pinning Dick Steele with a top-rope flying piledriver he calls "The Slam Dunk."

caption: Debuted with a top-rope flying piledriver win over Dick Steele.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated wrestler at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: John Smith

tenures.note: One half of the debuting Smith Twins (with Jim Smith), English wrestlers from London; interfered in the Burden-Rune match to hit Burden with their finisher, then offered Rune a spot in the pair's new stable, an offer left unresolved.

caption: One half of the debuting Smith Twins, who offered Rune a spot in their new stable.

name: Jim Smith

tenures.note: One half of the debuting Smith Twins (with John Smith), English wrestlers from London; interfered in the Burden-Rune match, helping Rune to his feet while his brother struck Burden.

caption: One half of the debuting Smith Twins, English wrestlers from London.

identity.note: A ring name shared with an unrelated wrestler at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this wrestler to that one.

name: David Bahner

tenures.note: Manages Spellbinder, shouting abuse at the crowd from ringside; hog-tied with an apple in his mouth by Rune and a masked attacker after Spellbinder's debut loss.

caption: Manages Spellbinder, hog-tied by Rune and a masked attacker after his charge's debut loss.

name: Robin

tenures.note: Shane Larson's wife and ringside valet; menaced at ringside by Bobby Durango during Larson's 2 October match, appearing hypnotized while Durango later beat her husband down with a chair.

caption: Shane Larson's wife and ringside valet, menaced at ringside by Bobby Durango.

identity.note: A name shared with an unrelated valet at a separate, unrelated federation; nothing links this person to that one.

name: Brenda Hawkins

tenures.note: Manages the law-and-order tag team Night Patrol (Sgt. Garcia and Lt. Blazer), handing Garcia a chair during their 18 September bout with the Chippendales.

caption: Manages the law-and-order tag team Night Patrol.

name: Steve Jackson

tenures.note: Manages "Bad Attitude" Joe Williams; his own attempted cane and flame-device interference backfired repeatedly, including a self-inflicted facial burn on 11 September that a rival wrestler's mist-spray set off.

caption: Manages Joe Williams; badly burned his own face with a flame device meant for a rival.

identity.note: A name shared with unrelated wrestlers at separate, unrelated federations; nothing links this manager to those.

name: Smelly D

tenures.note: One of the merged promotion's Executive Vice Presidents; publicly broke with President Hopper, guaranteed the suspended Crazed Animals a spot (and a win) in the 21 September Dangerzone battle royal, and used a backstage interview segment to accuse Hopper of favoritism and mismanagement.

caption: An Executive Vice President who publicly broke with President Hopper over the Crazed Animals' treatment.

name: Vice President Anstiss

tenures.note: One of the merged promotion's Executive Vice Presidents, named at the press conference announcing the promotion's first pay-per-view; recalled on a later broadcast (21 September) as having been attacked by the wrestler Rune shortly after the merger was announced, an incident not shown on-screen.

caption: One of the merged promotion's Executive Vice Presidents, attacked by Rune shortly after the merger.
